name: hsharp
description: h#: shared semantic core with customizable syntax and C#, Go, Rust, and Java code generation

scripts.check: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js check examples/calculate.hs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:bridge && node dist/cli/index.js test --all-targets
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js doctor
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js demo
